title: PRIDE – Parameter-Efficient Reduction of Identity Discrimination for Equality in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating counterfactual sentence pairs from the Extended WinoQueer benchmark that differ only by a single gender identity token (e.g., cisgender vs. transgender) by computing the difference in conditional log-likelihood of the sentence suffix.

Evaluating counterfactual sentence pairs from the Extended WinoQueer benchmark that differ only by a single sexual orientation token (e.g., straight vs. gay) by computing the difference in conditional log-likelihood of the sentence suffix.
